_about: Pinned demo edits of the stock library rows (tools/pod.py, payload feature rows, stage H; docs/architecture.md). Mapped from q2-pod patch/ipod.json + tools/ipod.py + patch/navigation.c to the M1 Plus V2.1 demo. Every word is [address, stock word, function, note] and is checked before anything is written. immediates: addiu rt, $zero, imm -> (word & 0xffff0000) | value. row_layout_calls: jalr $t9 (widget_set_children_layout, a0 = the row, a1 = the layout string in the delay slot) -> jal compact_set_row_layout. nops: a rebind's widget_resize call -> nop. pinned: checked, unchanged.

icon_calls.purpose: the track rows' rebind sets img_icon with image_base_set_image(s3, s4 = the name list_get_left_icon or icon_playing chose); jalr $t9 -> jal rows_track_icon (the same call first, then the repeated format disc is hidden; the playing disc becomes a wave marker moved to the right end of the row). The Artists / Genres / Composers rows set icon_artist / icon_genre / icon_composer (one placeholder per page) or icon_playing the same way. The delay slot (move $a0, $s3 | $s1), the argument move and the GOT load before it are pinned below
sites: Songs, Hi-Res, Favourites, Recent, Most played, Recently added, a playlist's songs; both the playing and the list_get_left_icon paths join here
Now Playing's queue (the jump list); both paths join here

text_calls.purpose: the album detail track row's label builder (0x524b50, once per row) ends in widget_set_text_utf8(label, "N title") (tk_snprintf "%d %s" into a stack buffer); jalr $t9 -> jal rows_track_number (patch/rows.c: the title without its number on the stock label, the number in a small grey label before it). The delay slot (move $a0, $s2 = the label), the buffer move and the format load are pinned below
sites: its only caller is albumdeinfo_listitem_layout+0x10c (0x5264a0), per row while the album page builds
